scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 26 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-the-park-of-the-farm-of-prince-of.story: 159 km from Peterhof to Peterhof, about 2 h 44 of riding. On the way it passes The Maritime Channel, The Park «Dubki», The Shuvalov's and back through The Park «Dubki». The line favours views over speed.
